next.AWAIT_BANK_TRANSFER: Awaiting your bank transfer. Finance verifies the funds, and only then does the order move to Payment confirmed — nothing is prepared or shipped before that.

next.PAYMENT_CONFIRMED: Payment is confirmed. The seller confirms the order next.
next.CONFIRMED: Confirmed with the seller. The seller prepares the items next.
next.PROCESSING: The seller is preparing the items for dispatch.
next.SHIPPED: Dispatched. It moves to Out for delivery on the carrier’s final leg.
next.DELIVERED: Delivered. A return can be raised against this order from Returns and followed to refund.
next.CANCELLED: This order was cancelled. Nothing further happens to it.
next.RETURN_REQUESTED: A return has been requested against this order and is being reviewed.

home.heroTagline: A modern marketplace for GCC trade
home.heroDesc: Find products for day-to-day purchasing or submit an RFQ for volume requirements—all in one GCC-focused marketplace.
home.prop1Desc: Business documentation may be reviewed before marketplace access.
home.prop2Desc: Review pricing, VAT and delivery details before ordering. Bank transfer is supported; online payment methods remain unavailable until provider certification.
home.prop3Desc: Set delivery addresses in supported GCC markets. Coverage, timing and tracking are confirmed for each order during processing.
home.prop4Desc: Capture quantities, specifications, target pricing, and delivery needs in one request.
home.b2bDesc: Submit detailed requirements, compare returned quotes, and keep purchasing activity in one workspace.
